Mod.Name: WereXIII
Mod.Description: IMPORTANT = This Mod must be placed at the top. This project was a long immense project. This project has been unreal. It started June 23rd 2014 and took 3 months. This mod replaces Red XIII, a quadruped Lionish with a full blown kick-ass Lycanthrope. This mod includes the battle model, field model, custom animations, 7 limit breaks, avatar and all casting animations. A lot of people have had hands in on this and I really appreciate it. If you find any problems or bugs or ideas on animation tweaks let me know. :::Thanks:::to those who worked directly on the project and especially CMH175, who I feel ended up more as a co producer than someone who assisted. CMH175 Leet Jeet Kaldarasha EQ2Alyza Kuroda Jusete And everyone who had suggestions and pointers. And all of the creators of the tools that were used for the project.
